caption: The drawing depicts a side view of a horse with a brown body and dark gray mane and tail. The horse stands on four legs, with its head turned slightly downward and to the left. Its hooves are black, and its ears point upward. The horse has a red, rectangular saddle on its back, bordered with some gold detailing, and a black line representing a girth strap extends beneath its belly. The facial features of the horse, including the eyes, nostrils, and mouth, are defined with dark lines. The background of the drawing is plain and off-white, and a rectangular, lightly drawn border frames the image. There is no scenery or additional objects in the composition. The bottom left corner contains the faint signature "ALMA LOWRY."
title: Toy Horse
cluster: #12 — Spanish Colonial Art of the Southwest
